text: {"lessons":["I made no trades in most periods, and that can be reasonable; I should act only when a decision is justified, not simply because a month has passed.","Selling Stock B and Stock E at a gain felt rewarding, but taking profits should depend on my investment judgment rather than the pleasure of locking in a gain.","My account rose and fell despite little trading, reminding me that short-term moves are unpredictable; I should assess each holding on its merits and avoid clinging to it just to escape the discomfort of admitting a mistake."]}
